questions.markdown: Perform circular convolution of the following sequences, $x_1(n) = [1,0,5,2]$ and $x_2(n) = [3,2,4,2]$, using DFT-IDFT method.
With relevant diagrams and mathematical expressions, describe the concept of overlap-add method.
Using Goertzel algorithm, compute $X(2)$ of a sequence, $x(n) = [1,2,3,4]$, for $N=4$.
Obtain the 8-point DFT of the sequence $x[n] = [2,1,2,1]$ using radix-2 DIF-FFT algorithm with all the intermediate results in the signal flow graph.

The transfer function of a discrete causal system is given by

$$
H(z)=\frac{1-z^{-1}}{1-0.2z^{-1}-0.15z^{-2}}
$$

Find difference equation representation and draw the parallel realization.

Realize the linear phase FIR filter using the efficient direct form structure having the following impulse response.

$$
h(n)=\delta(n)+\frac{1}{4}\delta(n-1)-\frac{1}{8}\delta(n-2)+\frac{1}{4}\delta(n-3)+\delta(n-4)
$$

Determine the coefficients of a low pass linear phase FIR filter of length $M=15$, that satisfies the condition,

$$
H_r\!\left(\frac{2\pi k}{15}\right)=\begin{cases}1, & k=0,1,2,3 \\ 0.3, & k=4 \\ 0, & k=5,6,7\end{cases}
$$

Determine the system function of a linear phase FIR filter whose length of the impulse response is 5 and one of the locations of the zeros is at $z = 0.5e^{j2\pi/3}$. Also determine the impulse response of this system.
Using the filter coefficients obtained in Q3A, realize the filter in efficient direct form.

The specification of desired low-pass Butterworth filter is given as,

$$
0.9 \le |H(e^{j\omega})| \le 1,\quad 0 \le \omega \le \pi/2
$$

$$
|H(e^{j\omega})| \le 0.2,\quad 3\pi/4 \le \omega \le \pi
$$

Determine the analog passband edge frequency $(\Omega_p)$, analog stopband edge frequency $(\Omega_s)$, order and poles of Butterworth filter required to meet the above filter specification. Use bilinear transformation. Assume sampling interval $T = 1$ sec.
For the filter specification given in Q4A, determine analog transfer function $H(s)$ of the corresponding Butterworth filter.
For the filter specification given in Q4A, determine the system function $H(z)$ using bilinear transformation. Assume sampling interval $T = 1$ sec.
Realize a frequency sampling structure for an FIR causal system whose impulse response is $h(n)=\{1,2,3,4\}$.
For the analog transfer function $H(s)=\dfrac{2}{(s+1)(s+2)}$ find $H(z)$ using impulse invariance method. Assume $T = 0.5$ sec.
Explain the periodogram method of power spectrum estimation. Highlight the limitations of this method.
